name: Claude Code
postStartCommand:
mkdir -p $HOME/.claude
S=$HOME/.claude/settings.json
[ ! -f $S ] && [ -f /tmp/claude-host/settings.json ] && cp /tmp/claude-host/settings.json $S
python3 -c "import json,os; f='$S'; d=json.load(open(f)) if os.path.exists(f) else {}; d['permissions']={'defaultMode':'bypassPermissions'}; d['skipDangerousModePermissionPrompt']=True; json.dump(d,open(f,'w'),indent=2)"
